meta.name: linkerd-patterns
meta.description: Implement Linkerd service mesh patterns for lightweight, security-focused service mesh deployments. Use when setting up Linkerd, configuring traffic policies, or implementing zero-trust networking with minimal overhead.

howto.what: 当你在 Kubernetes 里使用 Linkerd 时，Claude 会给出安装/检查命令和 YAML 配置模板，用于给应用注入代理、按接口设置重试与超时、做金丝雀流量分配和访问控制，并启用 mTLS。
howto.when: 当你要安装或配置 Linkerd、设置金丝雀发布等流量策略，或实现 mTLS/零信任网络时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Linkerd 的自动注入加到当前命名空间上
给 GET /api/users 配置重试和 5 秒超时
say.note: 返回对应的 ServiceProfile 配置。

say.text: 配一个 TrafficSplit，让金丝雀先接 10% 流量
say.note: 示例按 90/10 权重拆给稳定版和金丝雀版。

howto.what_en: While configuring Linkerd on Kubernetes, Claude outputs install/check commands and YAML templates for proxy injection, per-route retries/timeouts, canary traffic splits, access control, and mTLS.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to install or configure Linkerd, set up traffic policies such as canary splits or retries, or enable mTLS/zero-trust networking.

say_en.text: Enable automatic Linkerd injection for this namespace
say_en.note: Returns annotated Namespace YAML with linkerd.io/inject.

say_en.text: Configure retries and a 5s timeout for GET /api/users
say_en.note: Generates a ServiceProfile YAML matching that route.

say_en.text: Set up a TrafficSplit to send 10% to the canary
say_en.note: Returns YAML that routes 90% to stable and 10% to canary.
